content: Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ yuɛřa x Musa
S uyenni, a aytma imqeddasen, inni ittwařaɣan s třaɣit n ujenna, xzarem ɣar Rrasul wanita, ɣar Arrays n ikehhanen n cchadet nneɣ, Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ,
wenni d amtiqqi i Wenni i-t-i-dd-issgeɛɛden, am mammec tuɣa Musa d amtiqqi di marra taddart nnes.
Minzi aɛuǧi n Wanita d ameqqran s waṭṭas x wenni n Musa, am ccan n ubennay n taddart imɣar x ccan n řebni nnes.
Minzi marra taddart tᵉttwabna zeg ijjen, maca Wenni ibennan marra d AREBBI.
Tᵉttwawekkeř i Musa marra taddart nnes am i yijj n umsexxar, maḥend ad iched x tmesřayin min xef ɣa issiweř netta.
Maca Lmasiḥ am Mmis ittwagg x taddart nnes, u taddart nnes d neccin, mařa neqqim nᵉtteṭṭef di řaman u deg uɛuǧi n usitem nnes ař aneggar.
Maca minzi Arruḥ Iqeddsen inna ...
“Aqa ass-a mařa tesřim tmijja nnes,
war ttᵉsseqsiḥem ca uřawen nwem maḥend ad t tesɛarem, am inni iɣewwɣen, am deg wass n ujarreb di řexřa,
umi d ayi jarrben řejdud nwem, qeǧben ayi, am ẓrin timegga inu arebɛin n iseggʷusa.
... s uya ɛiffeɣ zi jjiř nni, nniɣ:
‘Wa d ijj n řgens i iweddaren deg wuř nnes nitni war ssinen ca ibriden inu!’,
ařami jjuǧeɣ deg weɣḍab inu: ‘War dd-ttidfen ca ɣar arraḥet inu!’”
S uyenni, a aytma, ḥḍam ḥima ɛemmarṣ war ittiři ḥed zzaywem ɣares uř d aɛeffan i war ittimnen umi ɣa taggʷejem x AREBBI iddaren,
maca qeǧbem ixef nwem kuř ass, ař ass umi qqaren: ‘Ass-a!’, ḥima uřa d ijj zzaywem war itteqsiḥ ca s uɣekkwi n ddenb.
Minzi nettwassmun aṭṭas ak-d Lmasiḥ mařa neqqim ncebbar zeg umezwar ař aneggar di Řɛahd-a i dayes řaman.
S uya ittwanna ammu:
“Aqa ass-a, mařa tesřim řḥess n tmijja nnes, war tesseqsiḥem ca uřawen nwem maḥend ad t tesɛarem.”
Xenni min iɛnan nitni inni isřin t, xenni ɣewwɣen? Ma war ǧin nitni marra d inni dd-iffɣen zi Miṣra s ufus n Musa?
Zi man wen iɛiff Netta xenni arebɛin n iseggʷusa? Ma war iǧi zeg yinni ixḍan, inni umi iwḍan iɣsan nsen di řexřa?
I umi ijjuǧ Netta, belli war dd-ttidfen ca ɣar arraḥet nnes? Ma war iǧi i yinni war d as ttiqqen?
Aqa nettwařa belli nitni war zemmaren ad adfen x ssibbet n břa l’iman nsen.
